title: Legacy Process Ordering, Temporal Semantics, State Acceptance & Transaction Boundary Audit

source_authority.role: B0 immutable historical source and revision-53 implementation authority for temporal reconstruction

testbank_authority.role: B0 historical input evidence only; no testcase modifications and no synthetic case promoted to B2

documentation_context.role: supporting historical concepts and nomenclature; not revision-53 implementation authority

historical_reference_status.ts01_consequence: no source-order or synthetic diagnostic result is promoted to B2 historical behavioural reference

main_source_order: Init: stage previous result into current/start representation
management packet read when event boundary is crossed
Addit: residues and management mutation; same-row addition before ploughing
Denitr plus optional grass uptake adjustment and Correction(1)

key_source_bound_findings.finding: The main clock is advanced to the interval end before Init stages state for that interval.
key_source_bound_findings.impact: t0 and t1 semantics must be explicit; Juda and Juda-St are not interchangeable.

key_source_bound_findings.finding: Legacy has a real current/start versus result/end generation split, but result-to-current staging occurs at the beginning of the next timestep.
key_source_bound_findings.impact: There is no literal atomic end-of-step commit in revision 53.

key_source_bound_findings.finding: Current/start arrays are mutated in Addit before uptake demand, rates and transport.
key_source_bound_findings.impact: ARCH01 immutable AcceptedState is not a literal legacy mechanism; a future trial must reproduce post-management read visibility.

key_source_bound_findings.finding: Management events use (t0,t1], while annual harvest/root-residue triggering uses [t0,t1).
key_source_bound_findings.impact: One normalized endpoint convention would move exact-boundary events.

key_source_bound_findings.finding: Within one management row, material addition is applied before ploughing/mixing and ploughing includes the reservoir.
key_source_bound_findings.impact: Management actions in a row are ordered, not commutative.

key_source_bound_findings.finding: Crop demand/selectivity is calculated after management but before transformation/transport; the soil-side uptake sink is applied inside transport and plant-side state gain is integrated later in Upintg_*.
key_source_bound_findings.impact: Separating uptake into new components can double-apply removal unless the soil/plant transfer is represented once.

key_source_bound_findings.finding: Potential Rates1/Transca/Resp_miner/preliminary NH4 precede aeration and the actual Rates2/process pass.
key_source_bound_findings.impact: Potential result fields are provisional and must not be treated as committed physical state or physical transfer events.

key_source_bound_findings.finding: Resp_miner immobilization availability explicitly reads previous-timestep neighbour Conh/Copo values and can perform one recalculation.
key_source_bound_findings.impact: Replacing all reads with newest same-step neighbour state changes the source algorithm.

key_source_bound_findings.finding: Generic solute transport and phosphorus processing traverse Sqnu flow order; same-step average concentrations are propagated to subsequent layers.
key_source_bound_findings.impact: Layer reordering or naive parallelization is not source-equivalent by assumption.

key_source_bound_findings.finding: Phosphorus transport, sorption/desorption and precipitation are coupled inside Transgen/Transorp per layer.
key_source_bound_findings.impact: No source basis exists for a globally reorderable all-transport versus all-sorption schedule.

key_source_bound_findings.finding: Outbal_calc observes the completed physical interval; Outbal_write then writes and resets reporting accumulators without accepting physical state.
key_source_bound_findings.impact: Reporting-period reset is not a transaction commit boundary.

key_source_bound_findings.finding: The final interval has no following Init; Output_Init serializes selected final Rs* result fields directly.
key_source_bound_findings.impact: Final restart material belongs to the end/result generation, not stale current/start arrays.

key_source_bound_findings.finding: Output_Init omits several temporal/reporting/external-owner continuation quantities and its macropore serialization block is commented; it also clamps negative Rsamplpo_act to zero while serializing.
key_source_bound_findings.impact: INITIAL.OUT purpose does not prove strong split-run equivalence or serializer purity.

key_source_bound_findings.finding: Input_hydro relies on sequential hydrology-record consumption; no direct per-record Tiwa equality assertion against the already advanced ANIMO interval timestamp was found in the audited input route.
key_source_bound_findings.impact: Hydrology-time alignment is an implicit coupling seam and should fail closed in a future adapter.

temporal_conservation_dispositions.material_addition: generated/selected before Addit; applied immediately to current state; Ad* reporting deltas accumulated later by Outbal_calc
temporal_conservation_dispositions.redistribution: applied in Addit after same-row addition; reporting deltas accumulated later; TCD-017 remains reporting-side and does not justify moving physical mutation
temporal_conservation_dispositions.organic_transform: potential pass is provisional; actual Transca/Resp_miner applies result and rates; balances observe afterward
temporal_conservation_dispositions.n_mineralization: actual Resp_miner creates organic result and NH4 source/sink terms; availability correction can use previous-step neighbours
temporal_conservation_dispositions.nitrification_denitrification: actual NH4 average precedes Rekoni assembly; NO3 transport then applies the assembled source/sink
temporal_conservation_dispositions.p_sorption: transport and phase transfers are coupled in per-layer Transgen/Transorp execution
temporal_conservation_dispositions.solute_transport: applied sequentially in Sqnu order; Toin/Toou/Av/Rs are reported later
temporal_conservation_dispositions.crop_uptake: soil loss occurs in transport; crop gain is integrated later from the same interval averages
temporal_conservation_dispositions.drydown: transport result guards execute before final balances; TCD-016 remains a missing-state/explicit-export problem
temporal_conservation_dispositions.report_accumulation: Outbal_calc/Outbal_write are observers and report-continuation state only
